items.source:
pub(super) fn alias_string<'a>(
    value: &'a Value,
    camel: &str,
    snake: &str,
    path: &str,
) -> Result<&'a str, String> {
    value
        .get(camel)
        .or_else(|| value.get(snake))
        .and_then(Value::as_str)
        .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
        .ok_or_else(|| format!("{path}.{camel} must be a non-empty string"))
}
